interface.longDescription: Finance & Data Analytics AI empowers CFOs, accountants, external and internal auditors, financial analysts, and researchers with AI-assisted financial analysis, IFRS and XBRL reporting, ISSB sustainability standards, PCAOB auditing standards, IIA Global Internal Audit Standards, SOX 404, CPA and CIA certification learning support, CPE professional education, public Big Four audit methodologies, ESG assurance, risk management, internal controls, fraud detection, and advanced data analytics. Educational and advisory support only. Not affiliated with, certified by, or endorsed by the IFRS Foundation, ISSB, PCAOB, IIA, CPA/CIA credential bodies, PwC, EY, KPMG, or Deloitte. No audit opinion or professional CPE credit awarded.
